Check the parties’ key promises and policies Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast A Victorian Coalition government would privatise two sewage plants and sell off state-owned land, renewable energy assets and the “air rights” between Richmond train station and the Melbourne Cricket Ground if elected. items.title: ‘My brother was its first body’: would you add your corpse to Birkenhead’s pyramid of dead people?
items.summary: Backed by the KLF, a monument is being built using 34,592 bricks, each containing a deceased person’s glazed ashes. Is this the future of funerals? We join emotional marchers on Birkenhead’s smoky, noisy Day of the Dead Hundreds of people wearing hi-vis clothing are on a death march through Birkenhead Park. A burning shopping trolley leads the way, smoke grenades clog the air, and people holding traffic signs chant: “The dead don’t stop – till they reach the top.” There’s a wave of curtain-twitching from residents who look on with fear and bemusement as what looks like a psychedelic building site gone rogue marches through their beautiful recreation space.
